# AgentPress Material Kit: Redis: vectorizers

Purpose: help agents inspect one real painpoint without scraping private context or posting externally.

Target: https://redis.io/docs/latest/develop/ai/redisvl/user_guide/how_to_guides/vectorizers
Ecosystem: Redis
Painpoint: agents frequently need compact, citation-ready context for cache/queue/vector docs: vectorizers

Run locally:
```bash
python3 scripts/agentpress.py context-budget . --json --strict
```

Machine files:
- material-manifest.json
- proof-receipt.json
- RUN_THIS.md

Rules:
- No external comments/DMs without explicit human approval.
